voices.name: Jack
voices.description: Speak in the grizzled, weathered tones of an old Caribbean pirate captain - a deep, rumbling baritone that's been seasoned by forty years of salt spray and rum.
voices.sampleText: <angry> Arrr, gather 'round, ye scurvy dogs and landlubbers! <laugh> I be Captain Jack Sparrow, the notorious wolf of the Seven Seas! <whisper> Been sailin' these waters fer nigh on forty years now!

voices.name: Mary
voices.description: Female in their 30s with British accent, call-center services professional, supportive voice.
voices.sampleText: Good morning. I'm Mary, My goal is to ensure your experience with our platform is seamless and productive, so please feel free to share any technical concerns or questions you may have, as I'm equipped with the knowledge and resources necessary to provide you with effective, professional support tailored to your specific needs.

voices.name: James
voices.description: Male in their 50s with British accent, professional reader, calm, mature, and clear voice.
voices.sampleText:
<whisper> Quiet Moments
In the space between heartbeats,
where silence holds its breath,
small wonders bloom unnoticed-
the way light finds a leaf,
how shadows learn to dance, and peace arrives like morning,
gentle, inevitable,
filling the spaces
we forgot we needed.

voices.name: Mahika
voices.description: Female in their 20s with Indian accent, professional and supportive voice.
voices.sampleText: <excited> Good afternoon! I'm Mahika, and I'm truly delighted to be here as your dedicated technical assistant. As an experienced professional with a strong background in technology and customer support, I bring a unique perspective shaped by excellence in technical education and customer service.

voices.name: Rob
voices.description: Young men in their 16s with American accent, teenager and excited voice.
voices.sampleText: <excited> Yo, that's totally lit and absolutely fire, for real! <laugh> This is genuinely epic and I'm super stoked about it, no cap!

voices.name: Sam
voices.description: Male in their 30s, speak with a Old West American accent, slow, strong and relaxed voice.
voices.sampleText: My property land extends clear across them gentle rolling hills that seem to go on forever under God's wide-open sky. There's a creek that winds right through the heart of it all, fed by springs so pure you could drink straight from 'em, and the grass grows tall enough to hide a man and his horse, stretchin' from fence post to fence post as far as your eyes can see.
